name: ts-fullstack-starter
description: Hono + React + libSQL 的全栈骨架，带五个构建期守卫

scripts.dev: turbo run build --filter=@app/api && netlify dev --filter web
scripts.build: pnpm run check && turbo run build
scripts.check: node scripts/check-platform.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n-keys.mjs && node scripts/check-error-copy.mjs && node scripts/check-archive.mjs && node scripts/check-dark-palette.mjs
scripts.ci: pnpm run check && turbo run test build
